clips.title: The story
paras: In the Stonetalon Mountains, Gaxim Rustfizzle seeks a powerful device and the means to fuel it. The gnome engineer sends you across the sea to Ironforge, where his old acquaintance Lomac Gearstrip can make a hazardous explosive compound called Nitromirglyceronium.

In the Stonetalon Mountains, Gaxim Rustfizzle plans his most ambitious engineering work yet. A mechanism of that scale needs fuel stronger than ordinary gunpowder or crude oil. He needs Nitromirglyceronium, also called NG-5, an explosive mix potent enough to ensure destruction if all goes according to plan.

Only one person Gaxim knows can refine NG-5: his old acquaintance Lomac Gearstrip. Lomac lives far to the east, in Tinker Town, the gnome quarter deep inside Ironforge. You make the long journey as Gaxim's courier, but Lomac greets you with immediate suspicion and paranoid questions.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The device I'm thinking about is my most advanced version to date. But we'll need a special potion if it's to work. I'm thinking we might as well get the good stuff since this mission could be your last.
And for that, we're going to need some potent explosives: Nitromirglyceronium.
The only person who can make NG-5 is an old friend of mine: Lomac Gearstrip. Look for him in Tinker Town.
You talk him into making us some NG-5, I'll get to work on placement for my devices.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ahhh.... Gaxim sent you, huh? How do I know you're not lying to me?! Hmm? Hmm...?
